classification_reason: The exact frozen file labels the case as a synthetic active-fraction sensitivity, and its K5-C3 report defines the 12 IDCs and 48 Rack-equivalent pools as deterministic virtual partitions and the capacities as planning sensitivities rather than installed physical capacity. The 48 power caps therefore are not a rated ESIF whole-facility IT capacity authority.

exact_capacity_authority.git_blob_note: The SHA-1 is the Git blob identity of the exact bytes, computed read-only; the external authority file is not tracked in the current repository.

published_loader_not_generator.role: Consumer of the frozen CSV, not the capacity generator

generation_lineage.generator_source_status: The exact stage driver/function that wrote the CSV is not retained in the published stage directory or review inventory. The execution log, manifest, pipeline, report, source fields, parent outputs, and exact row-wise formula remain available; no generator name is inferred.

parent_k5_c2_rack_parameters.role: Supplies the 12-by-4 virtual Rack-equivalent topology and Eagle-derived relative heterogeneity

earliest_available_absolute_power_source.semantics: Measured NLR run-level gross and incremental IT-power parameters mapped by requested GPU count; PUE is not applied

earliest_available_relative_rack_source.semantics: Relative Rack heterogeneity and power-headroom calibration only; not absolute H100 power or Melbourne/ESIF installed capacity

lineage_summary: Pre-2025 Kestrel workload concurrency sets the q99.5/u85 installed H100-equivalent planning scale.
Eagle data supplies relative virtual-pool heterogeneity, not physical 48-Rack identities or absolute ESIF capacity.
NLR GenAI supplies the absolute per-GPU IT idle/incremental power parameters.
K5-C3 applies the base 0.85 active-fraction sensitivity and publishes the 48 virtual capacity rows.

capacity_formula_audit.pue_application_boundary: PUE is applied later, after aggregation of IT-side Rack power, to form facility/PCC power.
capacity_formula_audit.designed_quantity: Total IT-side power capacity of each logical Rack-equivalent pool, including its allocated idle IT term plus the incremental power envelope at deliverable active-GPU capacity; it is not a flexible-increment-only service limit.
capacity_formula_audit.source_characterization: Engineered/synthesized planning sensitivity using measured per-GPU power inputs and measured relative heterogeneity; not physical 48-Rack telemetry, not an ESIF rating, and not calibrated to the V16 ESIF P_IT_REF target.

old_v14_v15_usage.generation_basis: Pre-2025 Kestrel capacity sizing, Eagle virtual-pool shares, and NLR per-GPU IT power, independent of the later V16 ESIF target.
old_v14_v15_usage.old_mapping: 12 deterministic virtual IDCs by 4 logical Rack-equivalent pools; capacity-proportional virtual spatialization, not physical Rack telemetry or geography.
old_v14_v15_usage.old_power_constraint_semantics: Old optimization paths constrained each Rack's fixed/background IT plus scheduled job IT against rack_power_cap_kw and constrained fixed plus scheduled active GPUs against deliverable_active_gpu_capacity; PUE was applied separately at the IDC facility boundary.
old_v14_v15_usage.old_flexible_workload_semantics: Flexible jobs consumed incremental Rack IT power and GPU headroom within the same total logical Rack cap; P_CAP was not a flexible-only limit.

old_expected_power_scale_kw.interpretation: The old logical model was internally bounded by a roughly 1.227 MW aggregate Rack IT envelope. Evidence does not establish a physical ESIF P_NF rating at this scale; consistency came from the virtual Kestrel case-study boundary and its capacity/slack policy.

authority_documents.role: Legacy implementation semantics: logical pools, pre-PUE IT caps, and separate facility PUE
Current authority: ESIF whole-facility P_IT_REF and Kestrel subsystem targets replace the old P_NF/G_NF active path

new_esif_scale_comparison.comparison_result: The V16 ESIF whole-facility Q90 target exceeds the aggregate legacy virtual Rack cap in all 96 April slots; this is a boundary/authority mismatch, not evidence that the ESIF facility physically lacks capacity.
